topics.label: Introduction to cancer hallmarks and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: It outlines the lecture structure, learning objectives, and the conceptual framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Growth signal autonomy and pathway deregulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in receptor tyrosine kinase, Wnt, and TGF-beta pathways enable sustained proliferative signaling and survival.

topics.label: Block to terminal differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how differentiation blocks prevent terminal maturation and drive malignancy in hematopoietic leukemias and intestinal carcinomas.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the molecular balance between pro- and anti-apoptotic proteins and how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through p53 and Bcl-2 family alterations.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, senescence, and stress surveillance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore telomere dynamics, mechanisms of senescence bypass, and how p53 integrates stress signals to enforce cell cycle arrest and senescence before summarizing cell-autonomous hallmarks.

topics.label: Metabolic rewiring and oncometabolites in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the shift to aerobic glycolysis, tissue-specific metabolic profiles, and Krebs cycle mutations producing oncometabolites that drive tumorigenesis.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis and vascularization
topics.groupedBecause: It addresses how growing tumors trigger the angiogenic switch to overcome hypoxia and recruit blood supply for nutrient and oxygen perfusion.

topics.label: Mechanisms, dissemination, and genetics of metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the metastatic cascade, circulating tumor cell monitoring, seed-and-soil interactions, and the genomic characteristics of metastatic clones.

topics.label: Lecture summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture with closing perspectives on the hallmarks literature and practical session housekeeping.
